mechanism: Both drugs increase dopaminergic and catecholaminergic activity in the CNS, with additive stimulant and psychomotor effects; armodafinil may inhibit CYP3A4, potentially increasing pramipexole levels.
action: Monitor for excessive stimulation, hallucinations, psychosis, tachycardia, and hypertension; consider dose reduction of pramipexole if combined; counsel on CNS side effects.
